## Description

Two starts of the same visit at the same moment (double click, two tabs) could fail: the losing start read no encounter for the visit, then the winner committed, then the loser's open-consultation check found the winner's encounter for this same visit and refused with "another consultation is open". The open-consultation check now ignores this visit's own encounter, so the loser goes on to the insert, meets the unique index and answers with the winner.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A start that reads no encounter for the visit and then loses the race to another start of the same visit answers with the winner's encounter, not "another consultation is open".
- [ ] **AC2.** A start whose insert meets the unique index answers with the winner's encounter (row-level security still applies to the re-read).
- [ ] **AC3.** The visit moves to In consult once and the board is told once.
- [ ] **AC4.** The lost-race interleavings are forced in the test (not left to parallel timing) and the test fails when the fix is removed.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
